entities.summary: Evgeny Igorevich Sivozhelez is a Russian male volleyball player. He plays with the Russia men's national volleyball team and won the gold medal at the 2013 Men's European Volleyball Championship. With his club Zenit Kazan he competed at the 2011 FIVB Volleyball Men's Club World Championship and 2012 FIVB Volleyball Men's Club World Championship.
